fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (41.8866,-87.6513) were already accurate to the building. Confirmed as 905 W Fulton Market, Chicago IL 60607 - a 5-story office building. Mondelez leases all office floors (~77,100 sq ft office + ~6,150 sq ft retail) as its global HQ, relocated from Deerfield IL in 2020.
fieldNotes.facilityType: This is a downtown corporate office building, NOT a freight facility. Zero freight relevance for yard management - it has no truck yard, no dock bank, no trailer parking, no gate.
fieldNotes.layout: Satellite z20 confirms the building by its distinctive green roof / landscaped terrace (matching published descriptions). It is a full-block-edge loft-style building flush to the sidewalk on all sides in dense Fulton Market.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No truck entrance - the building meets the public sidewalk directly. Curbside delivery only. truckGate/guardShack/remoteGs all false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No loading-dock bank. Set NONE; dockDoorCount=1 as a nominal allowance for an interior freight-elevator / service door reached from the alley or curb - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Set true: any delivery truck must stop curbside on a dense downtown street, which interrupts traffic - there is zero off-street stacking room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban core (Fulton Market, Chicago) - unambiguously Urban.
